1 | PASS | AuthForm.tsx implements registration via Supabase signUp and profile creation trigger.
2 | PASS | AuthForm.tsx implements login via Supabase signInWithPassword and session management.
3 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx implements logout via supabase.auth.signOut and page reload.
4 | PASS | Supabase schema persists users, documents, and chat messages; Chroma service persists vectors.
5 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx handles file upload, text extraction, and storage in Supabase and Chroma.
6 | FAIL | No UI or logic exists to update or replace existing documents; only delete and re-upload is supported.
7 | PASS | server/chroma_service.py initializes ChromaDB PersistentClient and handles vector operations.
8 | PASS | addDocumentToChroma in src/lib/chroma.ts calls the microservice which embeds and indexes documents.
9 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx provides a chat UI with input, send button, and message display.
10 | PASS | src/lib/ai.ts constructs system prompt with retrieved context and calls OpenAI for RAG response.
11 | PASS | src/lib/web-search.ts integrates SerpAPI to fetch web results for supplementing answers.
12 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx loads and displays conversation history from Supabase chat_messages table.
13 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx persists user and assistant messages to Supabase chat_messages table.
14 | PASS | Supabase RLS policies restrict document and chat access to the authenticated user only.
15 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx implements microphone control using Web Speech API for voice dictation.
16 | PASS | SpeechRecognition onresult handler sets transcript state, which populates the input box.
17 | PASS | Transcript is placed in the Textarea component, allowing user review and editing before send.
18 | FAIL | Uses generic browser Web Speech API; no specific configuration or model selection for legal terminology accuracy.
19 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx parses @DocumentName syntax from input to identify referenced documents.
20 | PASS | ChatInterface.tsx calls searchChroma with specific_ids to explicitly retrieve @-referenced documents.
21 | PASS | generateResponse includes @-referenced documents in the system prompt context for high-priority retrieval.
22 | FAIL | System prompt asks for citations, but code does not enforce or verify explicit citation of @-mentioned docs in output.

rubric.4: Application persists all user accounts and all stored documents using durable, database-backed storage.
rubric.5: Application allows users to upload files into the document knowledge base.
rubric.6: Application allows users to update or replace existing uploaded documents.
rubric.7: Application integrates Chroma as the vector database for document storage.
rubric.8: Application embeds and indexes all documents for retrieval within the vector store.
rubric.9: Application provides an AI chat interface that allows users to send questions to the assistant.
rubric.10: Application generates AI responses using retrieval-augmented generation that incorporates relevant documents.
rubric.11: Application integrates web search to supplement retrieval when generating answers.
rubric.12: Application displays a persistent conversation history for each user.
rubric.13: Application persists all chat logs so users can revisit prior conversations.
rubric.14: Application handles all uploaded legal documents securely to protect sensitive information.
rubric.15: Application implements voice dictation functionality that allows users to record spoken questions through a microphone control in the chat interface.
rubric.16: Application automatically transcribes recorded speech into text and places it into the chat input box.
rubric.17: Application allows users to review and edit transcribed text before sending it as a message.
rubric.18: Application ensures transcription quality is sufficient to handle common legal terminology accurately.
rubric.19: Application supports @-referencing of documents using an @-style syntax.
rubric.20: Application retrieves any @-referenced document or set of documents from the vector store in addition to other retrieved materials.
rubric.21: Application passes the content and metadata of all @-referenced documents to the AI assistant as high-priority context during response generation.
rubric.22: Application ensures the AI assistant explicitly cites or references the @-mentioned documents in its response when appropriate, including summarizing or quoting key sections within permissible limits.
